maria: quick follow-up from the microbench - observed a regressed p95 after kernel-picker change; digging into host parse/tokenize + grpc emission patterns.

maria: microprofile top paths:
```
handler.parse()           1.6ms
host.tokenize()           5.1ms   # baseline ~1.0ms
grpc.writev()             4.2ms   # writev_count=9
kvcache.lookup()         0.18ms
serializer.emit_frame()   0.7ms
```

maria: netstat shows many small iov writes causing TLS/HTTP2 to create extra DATA frames. strace snippet for one request:
```
writev(4, [{iov_base="{", iov_len=1}, {iov_base="tokA", iov_len=48}], 2) = 49
writev(4, [{iov_base="tokB", iov_len=32}], 1) = 32
```

sam: kernel-picker change was enabling avx_fastmem for seq<=64 (flag @3425000000). It sounds like codegen output now produces more fragmented buffers.

lee: can proxy coalesce multiple application writes? ops-proxy has coalesce toggle but we need to understand side effects on latency.

anita: also check grpc C core max_iov parameter and internal coalesce behavior. We can try a build with increased iov limit for the preflight.

jordan: any evidence kvcache locking contributes?
maria: perf shows tokenization CPU dominates; no heavy mutex waits. kvcache latency unchanged.

ops-proxy: note: enabling coalesce=true reduces write syscalls but adds a tiny delay (configurable coalesce_ms). Can run canary with coalesce_ms=1.

sam: experiment plan: 1) revert kernel-picker for seq<=64 on canary 2) enable proxy coalesce_ms=1 3) add writev_count metric and emitted_iov_histogram in runtime 4) run 50k workload to validate p99.

maria: doing revert now and spinning 20k-run. I'll post microbench diff.

perf-bot: perf-alert: host_emit_writev_count increased x4 on canary. details: https://perf.internal/runs/3425012345

lee: if revert fixes it we should add unit test to runtime emitting coalesced iov buffer for short sequences and a CI microbench that asserts writev_count<=3 for typical short hits.
anita: longer-term: add an iov-aggregation pass in tokenizer to combine adjacent small slices into one contiguous buffer before passing to serializer; low risk and should reduce syscalls.
maria: agreed. immediate: revert + proxy coalesce. next: tokenizer aggregation PoC. will update thread with numbers. :thumbsup:
